flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code to cancel or close a refund advice. Only the ocms_refund_notice record exists (ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsRefundNotice; controller only create and refundnoticelist) without a status column. The Epic46 refund approval pages in ocmsadminui/src/App.tsx are inside a comment block; there is no Cumulus interface.
note: Story status is 'No requirement' in stories.json (the requirement is not given); traced as a normal story. None of the three steps has code: approve cancel, close the work item, and hold back the Cumulus interface. That nothing is sent to Cumulus is true only because that interface was never built. Refund tickets (OCMS-SR-2026-112, OCMS-SR-2026-190) do not change the verdict. Cumulus: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Do not claim. Closing the work item and cancelling a refund advice are not in the code.

steps.step: The officer approves the decision to cancel the refund advice (no duplicate payment)
steps.detail: There is no cancel/approve decision for refunds. The OcmsRefundNotice entity (lines 19-62) has no status or decision column, and the refund approval UI (App.tsx:353-358) is inside a comment block. Same as OCMS46.2 steps 1 and 3.

steps.step: OCMS closes the refund advice work item
steps.detail: There is no work item that can be closed. The refund controller only has POST /refundnotice (create, line 43) and POST /refundnoticelist (list, line 76), with no update or close; the ocms_refund_notice table has no status column that could be set to closed (OcmsRefundNotice.java:26-58). Work items in OCMS are only a PLACEHOLDER for DataHive cases (DataHiveUenFinService.java:2920-2923), unrelated to refunds.

steps.step: The cancelled refund advice is not interfaced to Cumulus
steps.detail: There is no cancel mechanism that holds back sending. The story outcome is true only by coincidence (no refund is sent to Cumulus), because the Cumulus interface does not exist at all (grep cumulus: 0 results in the six repos), not because of a cancel. A refund record that is cancelled in business terms keeps the same state in ocms_refund_notice and still shows in the Payment tab of notice detail (PaymentDetails.tsx:126-144). Not claimed as Sesuai.
